for name,source in data["sources"].items():
 b=source.encode("utf-8")
 tree=ast.parse(source,name+".py")
 allowed=(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.FunctionDef,ast.ClassDef,ast.Assign,ast.AnnAssign,ast.Expr,ast.If)
 if any(not isinstance(n,allowed) for n in tree.body):raise ValueError("unexpected module declaration")
 out["source_pins"][name]={"bytes":len(b),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),"git":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()}
 m=types.ModuleType(name);m.__file__="<immutable-memory-source:"+name+">";sys.modules[name]=m
 exec(compile(tree,m.__file__,"exec"),m.__dict__)
prod=sys.modules["towerops"]; replay=sys.modules["audit_replay"]; adapter=sys.modules["decision_trace"]
def chain(records):
 events=[];prev="0"*64
 for i,raw in enumerate(records):
  e={"seq":i,"kind":raw["kind"],"payload":copy.deepcopy(raw["payload"]),"prev_hash":prev}
  canonical=json.dumps(e,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
  prev=hashlib.sha256(prev.encode("ascii")+b"\n"+canonical).hexdigest()
  e["event_hash"]=prev;events.append(e)
 return events
cases=copy.deepcopy(data["oracle"]["rows"])
control=data["oracle"]["extra_control"]
base=next(r for r in cases if r["id"]==control["from"])
cases.append({"id":control["id"],"events":base["events"],"expected":control["expected"],"tamper":True})
for row in cases:
 events=chain(row["events"])
 if row.get("tamper"):events[-1]["payload"]["before_world_hash"]="changed-without-rehash"
 before=json.dumps(events,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))
 item={"id":row["id"],"input_sha256":hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),"input_bytes":len(before.encode()),"expected":row["expected"],"independent_chain_check":prod.AuditLog.verify(events)}
 report=replay.replay_audit(events)
 item["api"]={"chain_valid":report.chain_valid,"ok":report.ok,"issues":report.issues,"advisories":[dataclasses.asdict(a) for a in report.advisories.values()],"rejects":report.rejects}

 item["adapter"]=adapter.review_trace(before)
 stdout=io.StringIO();stderr=io.StringIO();oldstdin=sys.stdin
 try:

  with contextlib.redirect_stdout(stdout),contextlib.redirect_stderr(stderr):
   rc=replay.main(["audit_replay.py","-"])
 finally:sys.stdin=oldstdin
 text=stdout.getvalue();err=stderr.getvalue()
 summary=json.loads(text)
 item["cli_entry"]={"argv":["audit_replay.py","-"],"exit":rc,"stdout":text,"stderr":err,"summary":summary}
 item["input_unchanged"]=api_unchanged and before==json.dumps(events,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))
 e=row["expected"]
 checks={"api_chain":report.chain_valid==e["chain_valid"],"api_ok":report.ok==e["ok"],"adapter_chain":item["adapter"]["chain_valid"]==e["chain_valid"],"adapter_ok":item["adapter"]["ok"]==e["ok"],"cli_chain":summary["chain_valid"]==e["chain_valid"],"cli_ok":summary["ok"]==e["ok"],"cli_exit":rc==e["cli_exit"],"cli_stderr_empty":err=="","input_unchanged":item["input_unchanged"],"issue_consistency":report.issues==item["adapter"]["issues"]==summary["issues"],"counters":summary["advisories"]==len(report.advisories) and summary["actuated"]==sum(bool(a.actuations) for a in report.advisories.values()) and summary["rejects"]==len(report.rejects)}
 if "advisory_count" in e:checks["advisory_count"]=len(report.advisories)==e["advisory_count"]
 if row["id"]=="present-mismatch":checks["original_diagnostic"]="actuation before_world_hash does not match screened world_hash" in "\n".join(report.issues)
 if row["id"]=="two-advisory-isolation":checks["valid_advisory_stays_clean"]=report.advisories["advisory-root-receiving-001"].issues==[]
 item["checks"]=checks;item["matches_frozen_expected"]=all(checks.values());out["rows"].append(item)
out["case_count"]=len(out["rows"]);out["matched_expected_cases"]=sum(r["matches_frozen_expected"] for r in out["rows"]);out["all_match_frozen_expected"]=out["matched_expected_cases"]==out["case_count"];out["actual_api_calls"]=len(cases);out["actual_adapter_calls"]=len(cases);out["actual_cli_entry_calls"]=len(cases);out["duration_seconds"]=time.time()-start
raw=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)
if len(raw.encode())>262144:raise ValueError("receipt bound")
